links.title: Pipeline Health
links.tooltip: Open the Pipeline Health dashboard (keeps the time range)

panels.title: Log volume per service
panels.description: Log lines of the service picked in the top bar (single select), optionally narrowed by the 'Line contains' textbox.

panels.title: Errors & warnings per service
panels.description: Lines with the words error/warn (word-boundary match, so words like 'OutOfMemoryError' inside echoed queries don't count) - independent of the 'Line contains' textbox, so accidental text there can't hide problems.

panels.title: Container logs
panels.description: Raw log lines of the ONE service picked in the top bar (single select, default kafka-connect) - services are never combined. 'Line contains' is a substring filter (e.g. ERROR). The time window comes from the top-right picker: it defaults to the last hour, and From/To accept absolute timestamps (e.g. 2026-09-08 09:00:00) to jump to an exact incident window. Natural reading order: oldest at the top, newest at the bottom. If the window holds more lines than the limit (5000), the newest ones are cut off - narrow the range or filter to pull them in; Loki keeps everything.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: One service at a time (drop-down, default kafka-connect) - log streams of different services are never combined.

list.name: filter
list.label: Line contains
list.description: Optional substring filter applied to the log lines, e.g. ERROR
